trig.hintDeg: From 0° to 360°. You can also type radians using π, e.g. π/3.
trig.hintRad: From −π to π. Type with π (2π/3, -pi/4) or as a decimal.
trig.proj: sin and cos of the result
trig.tanNo: tan {x} is undefined, so this formula can't be used.
trig.denom0: The denominator is 0: tan({g}) is undefined
trig.legB: β (the arc shows the turn from α)
trig.whereFrom: Where do these values come from? →

live.r1: sin θ = 0: csc θ is undefined for this angle.
live.r2: cos θ = 0: sec θ is undefined for this angle.
live.r3: tan θ or cot θ is undefined for this angle.
live.q1: cos θ = 0: can't divide, tan θ is undefined.
live.q2: sin θ = 0: can't divide, cot θ is undefined.
live.p2: For this angle tan and sec are undefined.
live.p3: For this angle cot and csc are undefined.
